tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background — neutral light grey; calmer than pure white on cheap LCDs.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, quiz options sitting on `paper`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inset wells: progress-bar tracks, input fields, empty states.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and resting card outlines (decorative, carries no meaning).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of interactive controls (quiz options, inputs, secondary buttons) — 3:1+ on `paper` and `surface`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`, every `-soft` tint, `kola`, `sunbird` and `lagoon`. Also the hard press shadow.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (meta, captions, helper copy) on `paper`, `surface`, `surface-sunk`.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `ink` fills (tooltips, the dark cover block, toasts).

tokens.name: kola
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. Primary button fill, streak flame, active tab. Text on it is always `on-kola`, never white.

tokens.name: kola-deep
tokens.usage: Orange as text or link colour on `paper`/`surface` (4.5:1+). Pressed edge of `kola` fills.

tokens.name: kola-soft
tokens.usage: Brand tint: selected states, highlight panels, the Today card. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: on-kola
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `kola` fills.

tokens.name: sunbird
tokens.usage: Track colour — AI. Fills for the AI chip, AI lesson cards and AI progress. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: sunbird-soft
tokens.usage: AI tint backgrounds. Text on it: `ink` or `sunbird-ink`.

tokens.name: sunbird-ink
tokens.usage: AI-coloured text (labels, chip text) on `sunbird-soft`, `surface`, `paper`.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Track colour — IoT. Fills for the IoT chip, cards and progress. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: lagoon-soft
tokens.usage: IoT tint backgrounds. Text on it: `ink` or `lagoon-ink`.

tokens.name: lagoon-ink
tokens.usage: IoT-coloured text on `lagoon-soft`, `surface`, `paper`.

tokens.name: hibiscus
tokens.usage: Track colour — Cyber security. Fills for the Cyber chip, cards and progress. Text on it: `ink`, never white.

tokens.name: hibiscus-soft
tokens.usage: Cyber tint backgrounds. Text on it: `ink` or `hibiscus-ink`.

tokens.name: hibiscus-ink
tokens.usage: Cyber-coloured text on `hibiscus-soft`, `surface`, `paper`.

tokens.name: correct
tokens.usage: Right answer: border, icon and text on `surface`/`paper`. Blue, not green, so it never relies on red/green hue alone; always paired with the check icon and a word.

tokens.name: correct-soft
tokens.usage: Right-answer fill behind `ink` text and the `correct` icon.

tokens.name: wrong
tokens.usage: Wrong answer: border, icon and text on `surface`/`paper`. Always paired with the cross icon and a word.

tokens.name: wrong-soft
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer fill behind `ink` text and the `wrong` icon.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind bottom sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with 2px offset, on every interactive element. 3:1+ on `paper`, `surface` and all `-soft` tints.

families.display: "Baloo 2", "Baloo 2 Ext", "Baloo Bhaijaan 2", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Ethiopic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.sans: "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Noto Sans Bengali", "Noto Sans Ethiopic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Wordmark, lesson-complete celebration. One per screen.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A sensor turns something in the room into a number.
styles.usage: Lesson reading text and quiz answers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Download this unit to keep learning offline.
styles.usage: Default UI copy. Never set running text smaller.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes. Not for anything a teacher must read to proceed.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip inner gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: meta lines, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between quiz options; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Screen-level separation; hero padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Celebration and empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips' inner icons, inputs, progress bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and quiz options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Lesson cards, sheets, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Track chips, streak counter, toggles.

shadow.note: Hard offset shadows only — no blur. They read as tactile, print well, and cost nothing to render on low-end phones.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Primary and secondary buttons at rest; removed (with a 4px translate) while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Lesson cards and quiz options at rest.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height/width of anything tappable — teachers often learn on small, cracked or shared phones.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size in buttons, chips and options.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the lesson column on tablets and desktop.

tokens.name: appbar-h
tokens.usage: Top app bar height, below the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: bottomnav-h
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation height, above the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: path-node
tokens.usage: Diameter of a lesson node on the UnitPath.

tokens.name: z-appbar
tokens.usage: AppBar and BottomNav.

tokens.name: z-banner
tokens.usage: ConnectionStatus and InstallPrompt banners.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: FeedbackSheet and other bottom sheets, with `scrim` behind.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: UpdateToast — always on top.
